Wednesday

October 21

Fly to Tokyo

Atlanta to Haneda

DL295Nonstop
ATL11:00 AMHND2:15 PM Thu
Details

Be at the gate an hour before departure.

You land Thursday afternoon. Thursday night is Nohga Hotel Akihabara; Shiomi starts Friday.

Thursday

October 22

Land, bathhouse, monja

Haneda, Akihabara, Kinshicho, Tsukishima

Easy night

  1. 2:15 PM, land at Haneda. Train to Nohga Hotel Akihabara: 51 minutes to JR Akihabara (¥480), then 6 minutes on foot. Drop the bags and rest.

  2. 01Evening

    Koganeyu

    Remodeled neighborhood bathhouse with a sauna, a big cold plunge, and a beer bar with a DJ booth for after.

    11 AM to 12:30 AM¥600 + ¥550 sauna
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    From Akihabara, the JR Sobu local three stops to Kinshicho, then 6 minutes on foot from the north exit. The bath is ¥600 for 90 minutes; the men's sauna is ¥550 more on weekdays (2 hours), and the big cold plunge is in the sauna area, so get the sauna. Tattoos are fine. Last order at the bar is midnight. Closed only on the 2nd and 4th Mondays.
  3. After dark
  4. 02Dinner

    Tsukishima Monja Street

    Tokyo's own griddle dish, cooked on the iron plate in your table. Over 80 monja shops on one street.

    Lines around 6 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Moheji Honten (weekdays 5 to 11 PM) takes reservations. Monkichi puts its average at ¥3,000 to ¥4,000 a head. Takenoko is the shop a Jungle Pocket comedian took over from his mom.

Friday

October 23

Senso-ji, Akihabara, MAPPA, Ginza

Asakusa, Akihabara, Yurakucho, Ginza

Anime day

  1. First thing, check out, Nohga holds the bags. Leave the bags at the desk. Suehirocho on the Ginza line is 4 minutes from the hotel and runs straight to Asakusa.

  2. 01Morning

    Senso-ji and Azuma Bridge

    Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, up Nakamise's 90-odd shops, then the bridge over the Sumida toward Skytree.

    Main hall 6:30 AM to 5 PMLit until about 11 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    From Azuma Bridge you see Philippe Starck's golden Asahi flame on the far bank. 5 minutes from Asakusa Station.
  3. 0211 AM

    Super Potato

    Retro games in Akihabara, back on the Ginza line.

    11 AM to 8 PM
    Directions
  4. 03Then

    Mandarake Complex

    Also in Akihabara: anime and manga.

    Noon to 8 PM
    Directions

  5. 1:30 PM, bags to Shiomi. Pick up the bags at Nohga. JR to Tokyo, then the Keiyo line to Shiomi. Check-in is 3 PM; if you're early the desk holds them. Then the Keiyo line back to Tokyo Station for MAPPA (the Keiyo platforms are a long walk inside the station; allow 15 minutes).

  6. 04Afternoon

    MAPPA EXPO

    15 years of the Chainsaw Man, Attack on Titan and Jujutsu Kaisen studio. Opening day.

    ¥2,000 timed ticketsLast entry 5 PM
    Directions
    Read more
    At Tokyo International Forum in Yurakucho, a few stops down the JR Yamanote line. Runs Fri 10/23 to Sun 10/25, 10 AM to 6 PM; tickets through Lawson Ticket. Same-day tickets (¥2,200) are sold at the door only if timed slots are left. If it's sold out, skip it and stay in Akihabara.
  7. 05Sunset

    KITTE Garden

    Free rooftop garden looking down on Tokyo Station's restored Marunouchi building. Sunset is 4:56 PM.

    Free11 AM to 11 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    6th floor of KITTE Marunouchi, a short walk from MAPPA. It can close in bad weather.
  8. 06Evening

    Nissan Crossing + Ginza buildings

    The Fairlady Z Version ST, Nissan cars on your drink, then Maison Hermès and Mikimoto.

    10 AM to 8 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Right outside Ginza Station exits A3 to A5. Renzo Piano's glass-block Maison Hermès and Toyo Ito's Mikimoto tower are a short walk.
  9. After dark
  10. 07Dinner

    Ton Ton

    Smoky skewer joint under the JR tracks since 1953. Beer to the sound of trains.

    Skewers ¥210Cash
    Directions
    Read more
    Mostly offal skewers over binchotan. About ¥3,000 to ¥5,000 each. No reservations, English menu. One minute from Hibiya Station.
  11. 08Late

    Bar High Five, Ginza

    Hidetsugu Ueno's basement bar, famous for his hand-carved ice.

    Mon to Sat, 5 PM to 1 AMNo reservations
    Directions

  12. 12:11 AM, last train home. Ginza-itchome, Yurakucho Line to Shin-Kiba, then JR one stop. Into Shiomi at 12:31 AM.

Saturday

October 24

Greenhouse, parasites, the yokai parade, Koenji

Yumenoshima, Meguro, Koenji, Nakano

Easy night
  1. 019:30 AM

    Yumenoshima Tropical Greenhouse Dome

    The one plant stop, one train stop from the hotel: three glass domes, about 1,000 tropical species and a carnivorous-plant room.

    ¥2509:30 AM to 5 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Last entry 4 PM; closed Mondays. Shin-Kiba is 2 minutes from Shiomi on the JR line, then about 13 minutes on foot.
  2. 0211:30 AM

    Meguro Parasitological Museum

    A small, free museum devoted entirely to parasites.

    Free10 AM to 5 PM
    Directions
    Read more
    Closed Mondays and Tuesdays, so Saturday it is. From Shin-Kiba it's 32 minutes on the Rinkai Line, changing to the Yamanote at Osaki.
  3. 032:30 PM

    Koenji yokai parade

    Billed as the biggest in Kanto: ghosts and monsters marching down Koenji Look street.

    Free to watchFinale 3:25 to 3:50 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Marching costs ¥3,000 and sign-up is in Japanese; only 6 of 250 spots were left on Oct 13.
  4. 04Then

    Nakano Broadway

    Old shopping arcade stacked with anime, manga and collectibles. One stop toward Shinjuku.

    About 10 AM to 8 PM
    Directions
  5. After dark
  6. 05Evening

    Kosugiyu

    Koenji's 1933 wooden bathhouse: milk bath, 44°C hot bath, cold plunge, under a Mt. Fuji mural.

    ¥600Last entry 1 AM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    A registered national cultural property. Four tubs: a milk bath (41°C), a 44°C hot bath with mugwort, yuzu or hiba cypress (changed daily), a jet bath, and a 16 to 19°C cold bath. Towels ¥100 to ¥200; soap and shampoo provided. 5 min from Koenji Station, north exit. Its site says nothing about tattoos either way.
  7. 06Dinner

    Taisho

    Three cheap, packed yakitori halls with a tare they've topped up for 40 years.

    5 skewers ¥814Cards OK
    Directions
    Read more
    About ¥1,000 to ¥2,000 each, no seat charge. One hall runs until 1 AM on Saturday.
  8. 07Late

    Koenji dive bars

    Alba En (8 PM to 5 AM), then Bar Tico (7 PM to 2 AM, cash only).

    Last train home 11:30 PM
    Directions
    Read more
    The 11:30 PM from Koenji gets you to Shiomi at 12:31 AM, with two changes ending on the last Keiyo Line train out of Tokyo Station. Stay later and it's a taxi.
  9. 08Optionaloptional

    An only-in-Japan party

    Three picks: Kawaii Monster Land's Halloween, MIDNIGHT STELLAR at ZEROTOKYO, or TOKYO DECADANCE.

    Read more
    Kawaii Monster Land, "The Halloween Monster" (Harajuku): Monster Girls stage shows, DJs and dress-up; book a 60-minute slot (¥2,800 to ¥3,500), open until 9:40 PM. MIDNIGHT STELLAR at ZEROTOKYO (Kabukicho, 11 PM, so a taxi home): TAKU INOUE, Moe Shop, PSYQUI, DÉ DÉ MOUSE and others; ¥3,500 fast pass, ¥4,000 door; crowd unknown. TOKYO DECADANCE HALLOWEEN (S Nightclub, Shibuya, since 2005): cabaret, cosplay, otaku and live-act floors, 9:30 PM to 5 AM, ¥5,000 door, ¥3,500 to ¥4,500 in costume.
  10. 095:30 PMoptional

    Tokyo Bay fireworks

    About 12,000 shells off Harumi Pier, 5:30 to 7 PM, back for the first time in 11 years. Tickets only.

    Read more
    Every viewing spot is ticketed (¥5,000 to ¥10,000 on Ticket Pia, paper tickets, no refunds), and you can't stop on a sidewalk to watch. Going means leaving Koenji right after the parade. Even if you skip it: the road in front of the Toyosu market complex is shut 3:30 to 8:10 PM, so expect crowds around Toyosu tonight.

Sunday

October 25

Ramen, Nissan HQ, NISMO, Omotesando

Yokohama, Harajuku, Ebisu

Lars's day
  1. 01Late morning

    Shin-Yokohama Ramen Museum

    Eight ramen shops in a 1958 street set underground. One bowl each.

    ¥450 entryBowls ¥900 to ¥1,500
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Seven shops from around Japan, one from Thailand. No reservations. Sunday 10:30 AM to 9 PM; 5 minutes from Shin-Yokohama Station. From the hotel: 53 minutes via Tokyo Station and the Shinkansen (¥1,470), or 1 hour 10 minutes for ¥766 on the Hibiya Line and Tokyu.
  2. 0212:30 PM

    Nissan global HQ gallery

    Nissan's own showroom at its Yokohama headquarters. You can get into any car on display that isn't roped off.

    FreeWeekends 10 AM to 8 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Beside Yokohama Station, one short JR hop from Shin-Yokohama. Open Sunday 10/25 (its closed days are Oct 5, Nov 2 and some December dates).
  3. 032 PM

    NISMO showroom

    NISMO's own showroom and Skyline GT-R works shop in Tsurumi. Taxi from Nissan HQ.

    FreeWeekends 10 AM to 5 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Run mainly by mechanics from Nissan's works racing program. Two display cars were swapped on Oct 5; no workshop tours; photos fine. Then JR back toward Tokyo for Harajuku.
  4. 043:40 PM

    Meiji Jingu

    A path through a 70-hectare forest, planted from about 100,000 donated trees, to the shrine. 1 minute from Harajuku Station.

    FreeGates close 4:40 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    It's at least 10 minutes' walk from the gate to the main shrine, so be through the gate by 4. Some facilities inside close at 4. If NISMO runs long, skip it and start Omotesando.
  5. 05Dusk

    Omotesando buildings walk

    From the Harajuku end: Tokyu Plaza, Gyre (MVRDV), Dior (SANAA), Tod's (Toyo Ito), Omotesando Hills (Tadao Ando), ending at Herzog & de Meuron's Prada Aoyama. Also here: Nigo's and Tadao Ando's Tokyo Toilet restrooms.

    FreeAbout 1.5 hours
    Read more
    The full walk, starting at Kenzo Tange's Yoyogi Gymnasium, runs 2.5 to 3 hours. Sunset is just before 5, so the shops are lit by the time you reach Prada. Omotesando Station to Ebisu is about 15 minutes.
  6. After dark
  7. 06After

    Ebisu Yokocho

    About twenty tiny food stalls. Sundays are dead in Golden Gai, so tonight is Ebisu.

    About ¥2,000 each5 PM to 5 AM
    Directions
  8. 07Late

    Bar Trench

    Absinthe and herbal liqueurs. #53 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026.

    Walk-in only6 PM to 2 AM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    No cover (10% service).

  9. 11:49 PM, last train home. Ebisu, Hibiya Line to Hatchobori, then JR. Into Shiomi at 12:31 AM.

Monday

October 26

Move hotels, Shibuya Sky, Kobe beef

Shiomi, Shinjuku, Shibuya, Golden Gai

Splurge night

  1. By 11 AM, check out of Shiomi. The desk holds bags free. Shinjuku is 40 minutes by train (JR, change at Tokyo, ¥341), or taxi it with the bags.

  2. 01Afternoon

    Thermae-yu

    Natural hot-spring bathhouse in Kabukicho. Monday is still the cheaper weekday price.

    ¥3,100 Mon to Thu24 hours
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Tourists with a tattoo get in if it fits under one of the bathhouse's stickers.
  3. 023:30 PM

    Shibuya PARCO, 6th floor

    Nintendo's own store plus the Capcom Store, Jump Shop and a Godzilla store. Fills the hour before Sky; Sky is a 5-minute walk.

    10 AM to 9 PM
    Website
  4. 034:30 PM

    Shibuya Sky at sunset

    Open-air rooftop 229 meters up, straight above Shibuya Station. Sunset just before 5.

    ¥3,400 onlineBook now
    Directions
  5. After dark
  6. 047 PM

    Fujita: Kobe beef teppanyaki

    The splurge. Counter teppanyaki at the Shinjuku Washington Hotel.

    Kobe loin ¥28,600 eachBook on TableCheck
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    TableCheck showed 7 PM tables for two every night of the trip when checked on Oct 12.
  7. 05Late

    Golden Gai

    Roughly 280 tiny bars in six alleys. Deathmatch in Hell, then Golden Gai red.

    Deathmatch: ¥666 drinksred.: 10 seats
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Deathmatch in Hell: metal, horror movies on the screens, ¥666 drinks, no table charge, 8 PM to 3 AM (shut Sundays only). Golden Gai red.: a 10-seat bar upstairs on 5th street where conversations between travelers and locals start on their own. Open until 5 AM; ¥1,000 cover.

Tuesday

October 27

Hakone ropeway, Fuji Motorsports Museum

Hakone, Gotemba, Shinjuku

Day trip

  1. 10:00 AM, romancecar to Hakone-Yumoto. From Shinjuku, arrives 11:27 AM. Reserve the seat ahead. Moved here from Monday so check-out day isn't a race.

  2. 01Midday

    Hakone Ropeway over Owakudani

    Over the volcanic valley to Lake Ashi. Get off at Owakudani on the way.

    ¥2,000 one wayAbout 30 min
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Mountain train and cable car up to Sounzan first. Ropeway 9 AM to 5 PM. Through Nov 3 the Sounzan to Owakudani section also runs a special Rose Gondola. Volcanic gas or weather can stop it on the day, so check hakonenavi.jp that morning.

  3. 1:55 PM, bus to Gotemba. Togendai to Gotemba Station, arrives 2:35 PM. ¥1,080, pay on board.

  4. 023 PM

    Fuji Motorsports Museum

    About 40 historic race cars beside Fuji Speedway. Taxi about 20 minutes from Gotemba.

    ¥1,800 (¥200 less online)Until 5 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    10 carmakers take part. Want a Hakone hot spring too? Do it the other way round: Fujisan 10:40 AM to Gotemba, the museum, the 3:20 PM bus to Togendai and the ropeway before 5, a bath at Hakone-Yumoto, and the 7:50 PM Romancecar home. Everything hangs on that 3:20 bus, which comes through Tomei roadworks and can't be reserved.

  5. 5:23 PM, fujisan express back. Gotemba to Shinjuku, in at 7:07 PM. ¥2,920 with the seat; reserve ahead.

  6. After dark
  7. 038 PM

    SAKE MARKET

    About 100 sakes, fruit wines and shochu in fridges you serve yourself from.

    Unlimited ¥3,800Last entry 10:15 PM
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    The old Kurand, by Shinjuku-sanchome. English menu, bring your own food. 90 minutes ¥2,700. Cashless only; bring ID.
  8. 04Last night

    New York Bar, Park Hyatt

    The Lost in Translation bar, 52 floors up, with live jazz and the night view.

    ¥3,300 cover after 6:30 PMLast drinks midnight
    DirectionsWebsite
    Read more
    Reopened in December 2025. No reservations, so walk in. Cocktails from ¥2,640 plus 15% service; the film's own is the L.I.T. (sake, sakura liqueur). No shorts, sandals, sportswear or sleeveless tops. A short taxi from SAKE MARKET to Nishi-Shinjuku.

Wednesday

October 28

Fly home

Haneda to Atlanta

DL294Same day
HND4:50 PMATL4:17 PM
Details

Winter-schedule times, later than before, so the morning is free. Leave Shinjuku by about 2 PM: Haneda Terminal 3 is 46 minutes on the Yamanote and the Keikyu (¥580). Be at the gate by 3:50 PM. Thursday's DL294 is the backup; Lars works Friday 10/30.

Soren: Duke spring registration opens 8:30 AM ET today, which is 9:30 PM in Tokyo, about four and a half hours into this flight. Neuroradiology (RADIOL 421C sec 41) has 2 seats and no waitlist, so enroll from the plane's Wi-Fi if it has any. The calendar backup now fires at 4:45 PM ET, after you land.
